mapper.insert: INSERT INTO openbiz_account (tenant_id, customer_id, balance, version, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{customerId}, #{balance}, #{version}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, customer_id, balance, version, status, create_time, update_time FROM openbiz_account WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, tenant_id, customer_id, balance, version, status, create_time, update_time FROM openbiz_account WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} LIMIT 1
